The CSV file has the same format as the file you get when you click Download Orders on the live results page. The response contains at most 750 days of orders. If the date range is longer, the response contains the last 750 days of the range. To get older orders, call the endpoint again with an earlier end or call the /live/orders/read endpoint. The response can contain orders outside of the date range. To get an exact range, filter the rows by their Time value. The response is a file download with the application/octet-stream content type.
